# Four strength days per week

**Decided:** Move to 4 strength days a week (an upper/lower-style split) instead of 3. The idea came from Scott asking whether to add strength days.

**Why:** He has weekday capacity: he can double on Mon, Thu, and Fri, and lift on the office days.

**Rejected alternatives:** A 3-day PPL, and RP's auto-generated 3-day hybrid. A Tuesday evening run was offered "if necessary," but Tuesday stays protected.

**Would revisit if:** unknown

**Approx date:** May 2026

**Source:** Building a custom mesocycle for armor training, 2026-05-18
